title: Spartan Boys Were Taught to Steal
hook: In Sparta's brutal agoge academy, boys were starved and ordered to steal—punished only if they got caught.

scenes.text: At age seven, Spartan boys were removed from their mothers and enrolled in the state military academy known as the agoge.
scenes.imagePrompt: Harsh stone courtyard of an ancient Spartan barracks with sparse wooden benches and dirt training grounds under a cool dawn sky. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: At age seven, Spartan boys were removed from their mothers and enrolled in the state military academy known as the agoge.

scenes.text: They were given only one coarse woolen cloak per year, slept on sharp river reeds they had to snap with bare hands, and went barefoot year-round.
scenes.imagePrompt: Bundle of coarse cut river reeds and a frayed red woolen cloak lying on a cold stone floor. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: They were given only one coarse woolen cloak per year, slept on sharp river reeds they had to snap with bare hands, and went barefoot year-round.

scenes.text: Instructors deliberately gave them starvation food rations to force them to steal food from farms and mess halls.
scenes.imagePrompt: Ceramic food bowl with only a few dry olives and a tiny crust of barley bread on a rough wooden bench. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Instructors deliberately gave them starvation food rations to force them to steal food from farms and mess halls.

scenes.text: Stealing wasn't considered a crime: it was tactical training in stealth, deception, and night foraging for future campaigns.
scenes.imagePrompt: Shadowy stone doorway of an ancient storeroom with hanging strings of garlic and clay olive oil jars in the moonlight. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Stealing wasn't considered a crime: it was tactical training in stealth, deception, and night foraging for future campaigns.

scenes.text: If a boy was caught, he was brutally whipped with leather thongs—not for the theft, but for the unforgivable clumsiness of getting detected.
